attacks.name: Integrated Armaments
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Aggressive Acquisition
steps: |!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_medium|.

|!critical| |!hit| |*Hostile Takeover|: After this attack is resolved, move 1 Asset or Civilian token the defender is holding to this character. This character is now holding that token. This character cannot hold more tokens than the Crisis specifies.

superPowers.name: Jump Jets
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 1 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Onboard Tactical Computer
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may use this superpower. This character may reroll 2 of its attack or defense dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Reinforced Armor Plating
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
